notes.title: Steam Community Items for Wavetale have been washed ashore!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687583/514b1a1da87b4b64dddb3522aa7361086e4414f4.jpg[/img]

Happy Monday friends!

And what a happy Monday it is! You, who have spent some hours in the waterproof shoes of Sigrid, you will now receive an additional reward for fighting the dirty paws! ːsteamhappyː Because as of now Steam Community Items are available for [b]Wavetale[/b]:

[list][*] 5 Emoticons
[*] 5 Profile Backgrounds
[*] 6 Trading Cards
[*] Badge (5 Levels + Foil Badge)[/list]

Have a great time everyone, and take care!
The Wavetale Team


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823930/Wavetale/
